characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Public dataset UHCS [11] (attached test data used); task type 'phase' (multiphase); 5 test images; resolution reported as 645 × 475 pixels in Table 1 and 768 × 768 pixels in Fig. 1; evaluation metrics IoU, F1 and Recall.
characterization_methods.purpose: Evaluate MatSAM training-free phase segmentation of cementite/spheroidite particles against expert labels and specialist models.
characterization_methods.key_findings: MatSAM IoU 0.76 (±0.7 %), F1 0.75 (±0.9 %), Recall 0.78 (±2.7 %); SAM IoU 0.58; OTSU IoU 0.56; Adaptive IoU 0.46; specialist IoU 0.71; MatSAM outperforms the specialist model by 5.0 % and identifies the vast majority of cementite particles.

computational_details.simulation_method: MatSAM training-free segmentation based on SAM, with multiphase prompt strategy (OTSU pre-segmentation for ROI points plus grid points)
computational_details.boundary_and_initial_conditions: category 'multiphase'; OTSU pre-segmentation for ROI points; grid points merged with ROI points (points closer than 3 pixels removed); crop sizes 1/1, 1/4, 1/16 with overlap ratio 0.5; up to 3 candidate masks ranked with NMS.
computational_details.validation_against_experiment: Compared with expert annotations and the specialist DL model; MatSAM IoU 0.76 vs specialist 0.71.

unmapped_findings: UHCS [11] is a public microstructure segmentation dataset classified under the 'phase' (multiphase) task, with 5 test images and evaluation metrics IoU, F1 and Recall (Table 1).
Reported pixel resolution differs between Fig. 1 (768 × 768 pixels) and Table 1 (645 × 475 pixels) for the UHCS dataset.

Table 3 segmentation results for UHCS [11]: IoU — MatSAM 0.76 (±0.7 %), SAM 0.58 (±8.2 %), OTSU 0.56 (±3.1 %), Adaptive 0.46 (±3.5 %), Specialist 0.71; F1 — MatSAM 0.75 (±0.9 %), SAM 0.73 (±6.6 %), OTSU 0.72 (±2.5 %), Adaptive 0.43 (±5.6 %); Recall — MatSAM 0.78 (±2.7 %), SAM 0.77 (±3.3 %), OTSU 0.59 (±3.2 %), Adaptive 0.93 (±1.3 %), Specialist 0.88.
MatSAM acquired the best results on three public datasets (NBS-1, NBS-2, UHCS) and ranked second on AZA; on UHCS it outperformed the specialist model by 5.0 % in IoU.
Across four public datasets (NBS-1/2, UHCS, AZA), MatSAM's average IoU was 7.5 % higher than that of the corresponding specialist DL models (aggregate result that includes UHCS).

The UHCS micrograph is classified as 'single crystal & multiphase'; the imaged field is a dark, rough SEM alloy crack surface densely and uniformly covered by light-coloured spheroidite (cementite) particles, with a few large faceted particles.
No specific heat-treatment or processing schedule for the UHCS spheroidite (cementite) particles is reported in this paper.
In Fig. 6(c), pink areas represent the masks overlaid on the UHCS image; MatSAM labels a much denser set of particles than the Specialist row, which leaves many particles unmasked.
